desc:
Welcome to Survive Fast Fredbear [DESTRUCTIVE]!!!

NOTHING will save you.
Fredbear is EXTREMELY fast, and everything around you can break. 
Walls collapse, floors give out, and your hiding spots won’t last.
Breaking system inspired by many games.

Can you keep moving when the world is falling apart?

Features:

⚡ Very fast Fredbear!!!!
💥 Destruction everywhere
🧠 Game of the century
👥 Play in private or public servers

How to Play:

Stay on the move
Don’t rely on one spot. it might not last.
Avoid Fredbear....

Credits:
Solo project by me!
Special thankss,,,, to YOU!! for playing :) it really means alot i hope you like my silly game.
